pages.title: <permission request title, e.g. "Run a shell command">
pages.purpose: Full review of one pending permission request (command / file / diff preview, requested patterns) with Allow once, Always allow and Reject replies.

elements.label: Copy command
elements.effect: Clipboard.setData with the pending shell command (_CommandPreview/_CopyButton).

elements.label: Copy {resource}
elements.effect: Clipboard.setData with the file path the request concerns (_FilePathRow/_CopyButton).

elements.label: Copy {resource}
elements.effect: Copies the full command, path or patterns from the request sheet code block.
gates: pattern not already shown as command/file preview

elements.label: Allow once
elements.effect: Answers 'once' through answerPermissionRequest; the request sheet closes and the receipt is carried by the conversation card.

elements.label: Reject
elements.effect: Answers 'reject' through answerPermissionRequest with the saved note where the server supports it; there is no second rejection pane.

elements.label: Always allow
elements.effect: KitRequestAlwaysAllow shows the scope before its risky switch; selecting it answers always through the controller.

elements.label: Tell the agent why, or what to do instead (optional)
elements.effect: Optional rejection reason held in _rejectMessage; autofocus; sent by Send rejection.
gates: _rejecting (after Reject… on a server that supports reject messages)

pages.title: Approvals
pages.purpose: One short choice list for how this conversation answers permission requests (Ask first, Auto-approve this conversation, Approve everything), with a Subagents switch while auto-approving, one quiet Set by line when inherited, and a collapsed Approved automatically history when not empty.
gates: !_conn.isIsolated (session menu and indicator are both hidden in the isolated demo)

elements.label: Ask first
elements.effect: _requestApprovalChoice -> controller.setSessionAutoApproval(sessionID, ask); leaving Approve everything turns the server-wide switch off.

elements.label: Auto-approve this conversation
elements.effect: _requestApprovalChoice -> controller.setSessionAutoApproval(sessionID, autoOnce). No confirm.

elements.label: Approve everything
elements.effect: Confirms in one sentence (in place), then controller.setApprovesEverything(true) and clears this conversation own setting.

elements.label: Subagents follow this
elements.effect: controller.setSessionAutoApproval(sessionID, SessionAutoApproval(mode: autoOnce, inheritToChildren: value)).
gates: shown only while this conversation auto-approves

elements.label: Follow parent again
elements.effect: controller.setSessionAutoApproval(sessionID, null): the session follows its parent again.

elements.label: Approved automatically
elements.effect: Opens the latest five automatically approved requests.
gates: only when the list is not empty

pages.title: [Approval mode chip]
pages.purpose: The always-present chip in the strip above the composer: names how this conversation answers permission requests (Asks first, Auto-approve, Approves everything, or paused while disconnected) with no count, and opens the mode menu.
gates: a waiting request does not hide it: the request card stays the main thing and the chip stays beside it

elements.label: Asks first (quiet) / Auto-approve (accent) / Auto-approve paused (semantics: "... Change approval mode")
elements.effect: KitChip.action onPressed -> onOpen(chipContext) -> ChatScreen._showApprovalModeMenu anchors the mode menu to the chip.

pages.title: Approval mode
pages.purpose: Compact menu anchored to the approval chip: switch this conversation between asking first, auto-approving, and approving everything on the server, or open the detailed approvals sheet.
gates: Auto-approve and Approve everything are offered only while the automation policy allows automatic answers (supervision below High); the current mode is always listed

elements.label: Ask first
elements.effect: Applies at once: controller.setSessionAutoApproval(sessionID, ask); leaving Approve everything turns the server-wide switch off.

elements.label: Auto-approve this conversation
elements.effect: Applies at once, no confirm: controller.setSessionAutoApproval(sessionID, autoOnce).

elements.label: Approve everything
elements.effect: Confirms in one sentence (Approve everything / Cancel), then controller.setApprovesEverything(true) and clears this conversation own setting. Cancel changes nothing.

elements.label: Approval settings…
elements.effect: showSessionApprovalsSheet(context, controller: _conn, sessionID).

pages.title: Message timeline / Fork from prompt
pages.purpose: Searchable reverse-chronological list of the conversation messages to jump to one, or (fork mode) to pick a prompt to fork from.

elements.label: Close timeline
elements.effect: Navigator.pop(context) with no selection.

elements.label: Search messages
elements.effect: onChanged -> setState; filters rows through TranscriptSearchIndex.search (fork mode: substring on role + preview) and shows the hit total.

elements.label: Load older messages / Reload recent history
elements.effect: widget.loadOlder (ChatScreen._loadOlder) fetches the previous history page; label is "Reload recent history" when olderNeedsReload.

elements.label: <message preview> · You/OpenCode · <time>
elements.effect: Navigator.pop(_TimelineSelection(message, fork: forkMode, query)); ChatScreen._openTimeline then calls _forkFromMessage (fork mode), _openFind(query, messageID) when a search was active, else _jumpToMessage(id).
gates: fork mode lists only forkable user prompts

elements.label: Fork from this prompt
elements.effect: Navigator.pop(_TimelineSelection(message, fork: true)) -> ChatScreen._forkFromMessage(message) forks the session at that prompt.
gates: widget.forkAvailable (_conn.capabilities.sessionFork) && _isForkable(message) (user role, non-local id, has non-synthetic text)

pages.title: <permission request title>
pages.purpose: Inline card above the chat composer for the oldest pending permission request; never authorizes from the summary.

elements.label: Review
elements.effect: onReview -> ChatScreen._showPermissionDialog(permission) -> showPermissionSheet(context, permission, controller: _conn, onShowSource: _jumpToMessage(tool.messageID)).

pages.title: <question title> / OpenCode needs input
pages.purpose: Inline question card above the chat composer: option rows, optional free-text answer, Send and More.

elements.label: Answer
elements.effect: widget.onMore -> ChatScreen._showQuestionSheet(question) -> showQuestionSheet(context, _conn, question).

elements.label: <choice label>
elements.effect: _tap: toggles/selects the choice; when single prompt and single-select (_answersOnTap) immediately _send() -> widget.onAnswer(answers) -> ChatScreen._answerQuestion -> _conn.answerQuestion(question.id, answers).

elements.label: [QuestionCustomAnswerField free-text answer]
elements.effect: onChanged clears the selection for single-select prompts; onSubmitted -> _send() -> widget.onAnswer(_serialize()).

elements.label: Send
elements.effect: _send -> widget.onAnswer(_serialize()) -> ChatScreen._answerQuestion -> _conn.answerQuestion(question.id, answers).
gates: enabled only when every prompt has an answer (_complete)

elements.label: More
elements.effect: widget.onMore -> ChatScreen._showQuestionSheet -> showQuestionSheet(context, _conn, question).

pages.title: <session title> (sections: Conversation, Display and context, Session actions)
pages.purpose: Single app-bar overflow sheet for a chat session: view destinations as chips, display toggles, then mutation and utility actions. Every row pops with a string value that ChatScreen._openSessionMenu switches on.

reachedFrom.widget: ChatScreen app bar IconButton key session-actions-button ("Session menu")

elements.label: Results
elements.effect: Navigator.pop(context, 'results'); ChatScreen._openSessionMenu then calls _openRunningWork() -> showRunningWorkSheet(...).

elements.label: Find in conversation
elements.effect: Navigator.pop(context, 'find'); ChatScreen._openSessionMenu then calls _openFind(): opens the in-transcript find bar (_findOpen = true).

elements.label: Timeline
elements.effect: Navigator.pop(context, 'timeline'); ChatScreen._openSessionMenu then calls _openTimeline().

elements.label: Changes
elements.effect: Navigator.pop(context, 'changes'); ChatScreen._openSessionMenu then calls _showDiff(): pushes ReviewWorkspace (or DiffView when isolated).

elements.label: Tasks
elements.effect: Tasks now opens the latest plan in the transcript via _openPlan; there is no Tasks sheet (chat/session_sheets.dart).

elements.label: Subagent sessions
elements.effect: Navigator.pop(context, 'subagents'); ChatScreen._openSessionMenu then calls _showSubagents(): pushes SessionRelationsScreen.

elements.label: Display and context
elements.effect: ExpansionTile: expands the display toggles and Context usage row.

elements.label: [TranscriptDisplayToggles: reasoning expanded / timestamps visible]
elements.effect: Embedded TranscriptDisplayToggles (lib/ui/widgets/transcript_display_toggles.dart, owned by another agent); ChatScreen handles popped values 'thinking'/'timestamps' via _runMobileCommand(_ChatCommandAction.thinking/.timestamps).

elements.label: Context usage
elements.effect: _SessionSheetRow (timeline_sheet.dart:15) pops 'context'; ChatScreen._openSessionMenu then calls _showContext(): pushes SessionContextScreen.

elements.label: Session actions
elements.effect: ExpansionTile: expands the session action rows.

elements.label: Use a skill
elements.effect: _SessionSheetRow (timeline_sheet.dart:15) pops 'skills'; ChatScreen._openSessionMenu then pushes SkillsScreen(controller, sessionID) (errors with skillLocationChanged if the location changed); on result true shows a composer note and reloads.

elements.label: Note for the agent
elements.effect: _SessionSheetRow (timeline_sheet.dart:15) pops 'note'; ChatScreen._openSessionMenu then pushes SessionNoteScreen(controller, sessionID).

elements.label: Approvals
elements.effect: _SessionSheetRow (timeline_sheet.dart:15) pops 'approvals'; ChatScreen._openSessionMenu then calls showSessionApprovalsSheet(context, controller: _conn, sessionID).

elements.label: Retry last prompt
elements.effect: _SessionSheetRow (timeline_sheet.dart:15) pops 'retry'; ChatScreen._openSessionMenu then calls _retryLast(): re-sends the last non-local user prompt.

elements.label: Revert last prompt
elements.effect: _SessionSheetRow (timeline_sheet.dart:15) pops 'revert'; ChatScreen._openSessionMenu then calls _revertLast(): showConfirmSheet, then repository.revertSession(sessionID, messageID).

elements.label: Restore messages / Review staged revert
elements.effect: _SessionSheetRow (timeline_sheet.dart:15) pops 'restore'; ChatScreen._openSessionMenu then calls _restore(): _reviewStagedRevert() when _conn.supportsStagedRevert (label "Review staged revert"), else repository.restoreSession(sessionID) and reload.

elements.label: Fork session
elements.effect: _SessionSheetRow (timeline_sheet.dart:15) pops 'fork'; ChatScreen._openSessionMenu then calls _fork(): repository.forkSession(sessionID), refreshSessions, pushReplacementNamed('/chat/<new id>').

elements.label: Compact context
elements.effect: _SessionSheetRow (timeline_sheet.dart:15) pops 'compact'; ChatScreen._openSessionMenu then calls _compact(): repository.compactSession(...) (needs a selected model unless the server owns selection).

elements.label: Share session
elements.effect: _SessionSheetRow (timeline_sheet.dart:15) pops 'share'; ChatScreen._openSessionMenu then calls _share(): showConfirmSheet "Share this session", then repository.shareSession and copies the link.

elements.label: Stop sharing
elements.effect: _SessionSheetRow (timeline_sheet.dart:15) pops 'unshare'; ChatScreen._openSessionMenu then calls _stopSharing(): repository.unshareSession(sessionID), snackbar "Session is no longer shared".

elements.label: Run shell command
elements.effect: _SessionSheetRow (timeline_sheet.dart:15) pops 'shell'; ChatScreen._openSessionMenu then calls _runShellDialog(): AlertDialog with a command TextField.

elements.label: Commands
elements.effect: _SessionSheetRow (timeline_sheet.dart:15) pops 'slash'; ChatScreen._openSessionMenu then calls _openCommandLauncher(): the composer tools / commands sheet.

elements.label: Continue on computer
elements.effect: _SessionSheetRow (timeline_sheet.dart:15) pops 'continue-computer'; ChatScreen._openSessionMenu then calls _continueOnComputer(): shows ContinueOnComputerSheet with the CLI resume command.

elements.label: Open on another phone
elements.effect: _SessionSheetRow (timeline_sheet.dart:15) pops 'continue-phone'; ChatScreen._openSessionMenu then calls _continueOnPhone(): shows ContinueOnPhoneSheet with the session QR / link.

elements.label: Reload messages
elements.effect: _SessionSheetRow (timeline_sheet.dart:15) pops 'reload'; ChatScreen._openSessionMenu then calls _load(): re-fetches the transcript.

pages.title: Voice conversation
pages.purpose: Strip above the chat composer while voice conversation mode is on: Speak replies switch, reply status, Listen / Stop / Read reply / Exit.
gates: entering requires an empty composer/attachments/handoff references and _conversationCanSend

elements.label: Speak replies
elements.effect: _setVoiceSpeakReplies(value): turning on runs _ensureSpeechReady (read-aloud consent and voice-choice sheets) then sets _voiceSpeakReplies; turning off clears the reply watch and stops a reply being spoken. Session-local state, not persisted.

elements.label: Listen
elements.effect: onVoice -> ChatScreen._openVoice(): the voice model setup sheet when no model is ready; otherwise voice is a composer mode (slice-P10.3, 3273d7ef) and dictation lands in the draft; no voice sheet opens.

elements.label: Stop
elements.effect: _stopReading(): stops read-aloud playback of the reply.

elements.label: Read reply
elements.effect: Resets _voiceReplyState to idle and calls _readReply(latest assistant message) to read it aloud on request.
gates: !speaking && !waiting && latest assistant message != null && _voiceReplyState in {reviewNeeded, interrupted, failed}

elements.label: Exit voice mode
elements.effect: _interruptVoiceConversation(): bumps _voiceEpoch, cancels the recorder and playback, clears the composer and leaves conversation mode.

pages.title: Local voice input
pages.purpose: Choose, download, re-download or delete the on-device speech model pack and pick the transcription language.

elements.label: <model pack name> (Default/Optional, Installed/Not installed, size)
elements.effect: manager.selectPack(pack): selects the pack to download/use.

elements.label: Re-download
elements.effect: manager.redownloadPack(pack): downloads the model files again.

elements.label: Delete
elements.effect: onDelete -> _confirmDelete(context, pack).

elements.label: Transcription language
elements.effect: manager.setLanguage(language) (VoiceLanguage.values).

elements.label: Technical details
elements.effect: ExpansionTile (_VoiceTechnicalDetails): expands the raw selectable error text.

elements.label: Not now / Cancel download
elements.effect: When busy: manager.cancelDownload(); otherwise Navigator.pop(context, false).

elements.label: Download / Use model
elements.effect: Installed pack: Navigator.pop(context, true) (caller proceeds to the voice sheet). Not installed and supported: manager.downloadSelected(). Disabled when busy or the pack is unsupported on this device.

pages.title: Delete {model}?
pages.purpose: Confirm deleting a downloaded voice model pack.

elements.label: Keep
elements.effect: Navigator.pop(context, false).

elements.label: Delete
elements.effect: Navigator.pop(context, true) -> manager.deletePack(pack).

pages.title: <tool title> (e.g. Shell, Edit, Task)
pages.purpose: One tool call in the transcript: collapsible header, generated file / image outputs, truncated output with See all, and the subagent-session link for task tools.

elements.label: <tool title> <subtitle>, <status>
elements.effect: _toggleExpanded: expands/collapses the tool input/output body and stores the state in widget.expansionStore[expansionKey]; starts expanded when status == error.
gates: hasBody (output, input, metadata or files present)

elements.label: Open subagent session
elements.effect: onOpenSession(sessionId); ChatScreen passes _openSubagentSession -> _openRelatedSession: persists the draft, switches location if needed and pushReplacementNamed('/chat/<child id>').
gates: task tool body, state.executed && sessionId != null && onOpenSession != null

elements.label: Show full prompt / Show less
elements.effect: setState(_showFull = !_showFull): expands the truncated delegated task prompt (_TaskPrompt).

elements.label: See all · {count} lines
elements.effect: showFilePreviewSheet(context, FilePreviewData(name: 'changes.diff', text: diff)) from the inline _DiffPreview.

elements.label: See all · {count} lines
elements.effect: showFilePreviewSheet(context, FilePreviewData(name, full text)) from a truncated _Mono block (cap 13 lines / 4000 chars).

elements.label: Retry image preview
elements.effect: onRetry -> _retryPreview(file): re-runs _loadPreview (data URL or widget.filePreviewLoader).

elements.label: Preview generated image {filename}
elements.effect: openPreview -> showFilePreviewSheet(context, data, onAttach, onDownload); ChatScreen wires onAttach to _attachToolOutputFile (only when _supportsPromptAttachments) and onDownload to _downloadToolOutputFile.
gates: output file isImage and bytes loaded

elements.label: Open generated file {filename}
elements.effect: _open: awaits widget.load() then showFilePreviewSheet(context, data, onAttach, onDownload).

pages.title: [Markdown content]
pages.purpose: Markdown renderer for assistant/user text: external links, validated file-path chips, code blocks with copy / wrap / full-screen, and agent fenced blocks.
gates: all interaction disabled when MarkdownInteractionScope.enabled == false (ChatScreen wraps the isolated demo in it, chat_screen.dart:7326)

elements.label: [label](url)
elements.effect: TapGestureRecognizer -> openExternalLink(context, url) (lib/ui/widgets/external_link.dart:48, which confirms in a dialog before launching).

elements.label: <inline code file path>
elements.effect: GestureDetector.onTap -> MarkdownFileLinks.open(code); ChatScreen installs open: _openPathLink (chat_screen.dart:6657-6659) which resolves the path and shows showFilePreviewSheet.

elements.label: Open full output
elements.effect: KitCodeBlock.onOpenFull calls the markdown host onOpenCode callback, opening its full-screen code reader.

elements.label: Wrap lines / Scroll lines
elements.effect: Same wrap toggle as the menu entry, shown as a plain IconButton when the block cannot expand (reader view, file previews).

elements.label: Copy code
elements.effect: _copy(originalSource ?? code): Clipboard.setData + "copied" snackbar; on failure a snackbar with a Retry action (line 1112) re-invokes _copy.

elements.label: Choose: {option}
elements.effect: AgentChoicesBlock._select: hands the option to AgentChoiceScope.onChoice (ChatScreen: _insertChoice inserts it into the composer, message_view.dart:1243); with no scope copies the option and shows a snackbar.

elements.label: Copy command
elements.effect: AgentCommandBlock._copy: Clipboard.setData(command) + snackbar. Also hosted directly by session_handoff_sheets.dart:70.

pages.title: Code reader
pages.purpose: Full-screen snapshot of one code block with wrap and copy controls.

elements.label: Wrap lines / Scroll lines
elements.effect: saveReaderPreferences(wrapCode) or local _wrap toggle.

elements.label: Copy code
elements.effect: Clipboard.setData(original source); controls retire when the source row disposes (_readerPermission).

elements.label: [AppBar back]
elements.effect: Implicit AppBar back button pops the route.

pages.title: [Question option rows]
pages.purpose: Shared option row and free-text field for agent questions.

elements.label: <choice label> (+ Recommended badge)
elements.effect: InkWell.onTap -> host onTap (select / toggle the choice; the chat card may submit immediately, see embedded-question-attention-card-option).

elements.label: Your answer
elements.effect: TextField with host-provided onChanged / onSubmitted.
gates: host shows it only when prompt.custom

pages.title: <form title>
pages.purpose: Renders a server Form.Info request: a bottom sheet for up to four short fields, otherwise a full-screen dialog route (formPrefersFullScreen); Send answers / Dismiss in a pinned apply bar.
gates: full-screen variant when form.fields.length >= 5 or any description > 140 chars

elements.label: <field label>
elements.effect: Free-text answer; onChanged clears the field error.

elements.label: <field label> (read-only, date)
elements.effect: onTap -> _pickDate: showDatePicker, then showTimePicker for date-time fields; stores ISO value.

elements.label: <field options> (+ Other…)
elements.effect: RadioGroup.onChanged sets _choice[key] or reveals the Other… free-text field.

elements.label: <field options> (+ Other…)
elements.effect: DropdownMenu.onSelected sets the choice or reveals Other….

elements.label: Other…
elements.effect: Free-text value for the Other… choice.

elements.label: <field label> (number)
elements.effect: Numeric answer; onChanged clears the field error.

elements.label: <field label>
elements.effect: SwitchListTile toggles _toggle[key].

elements.label: <added custom value> [x]
elements.effect: InputChip.onDeleted removes a custom multiselect value.

elements.label: Add your own
elements.effect: onSubmitted / suffix IconButton "Add answer" (line 1014) -> _addCustomValue(field).
gates: multiselect field that allows custom values

elements.label: <option> FilterChip
elements.effect: _toggleOption(field, value, selected).

elements.label: <option> CheckboxListTile
elements.effect: _toggleOption(field, value, selected) for longer option lists.

elements.label: <field label> / Open link
elements.effect: openExternalLink(context, field.url) (confirmation dialog then url launch, lib/ui/widgets/external_link.dart:48).

elements.label: Send answers
elements.effect: _submit: validates active fields, then widget.onSubmit(answers) (presentConnectionForm -> connection.replyForm(form.id, answer)) and onClose pops the surface; inline banner on error.

elements.label: Dismiss
elements.effect: _dismiss: showConfirmSheet "Dismiss this request?".

pages.title: Dismiss this request?
pages.purpose: Confirms dismissing a form request; the agent continues without the answers.

elements.label: Dismiss
elements.effect: Resolves true -> widget.onCancel() (presentConnectionForm cancels/rejects the form on the server) then onClose.

elements.label: Cancel
elements.effect: showConfirmSheet resolves false.

pages.title: [Material date picker, then time picker for date-time fields]
pages.purpose: Stock showDatePicker (1900-2100) followed by showTimePicker when the field is a date-time.

elements.label: [OK]
elements.effect: Returns the picked date/time into _dateIso[field.key].

elements.label: [Cancel]
elements.effect: Returns null; nothing changes.

notes: lib/ui/screens/chat/session_sheets.dart:111 _DiffSheet is dead code: no constructor call anywhere in lib/ (ChatScreen._showDiff at chat_screen.dart:5795 pushes ReviewWorkspace/DiffView instead).
lib/ui/screens/chat/attention_card.dart:441 _RetryAttentionCard and :466 _ComposerNote have no interactive elements (display-only banners in ChatScreen attention slot).

lib/ui/screens/chat/attention_card.dart:499 SessionMenuSheet rows only pop a string; targets were resolved by reading ChatScreen._openSessionMenu (chat_screen.dart:5500-5619). Target ids for chat-owned confirm surfaces (chat-revert-confirm-sheet, chat-share-confirm-sheet, chat-run-shell-dialog, chat-command-launcher-sheet) are guesses; resolve by targetWidget method name.

lib/ui/widgets/agent_blocks.dart: AgentChoicesBlock / AgentCommandBlock elements are attached to embedded-markdown-text (they are only built by markdown.dart:364-370, plus AgentCommandBlock directly in session_handoff_sheets.dart:70). AgentChecklistBlock is display-only.

lib/ui/widgets/markdown.dart:749 and form_renderer.dart:1132 call openExternalLink (lib/ui/widgets/external_link.dart:48, not assigned to me) which shows its own confirmation dialog at external_link.dart:68; that dialog page belongs to whoever owns external_link.dart.

Target id file-preview-sheet (showFilePreviewSheet, lib/ui/widgets/file_preview.dart:161) and run-result (RunResultScreen), review-workspace, session-relations, session-context, skills, session-note, running-work-sheet, question-sheet, continue-on-*-sheet ids are derived by the naming rule; resolve by targetWidget.
form_renderer.dart line numbers for field controls were taken from the interaction grep (656, 678, 756, 805, 873, 891, 931, 994, 1007, 1047, 1091, 1131); field labels are server-provided.
